name: net.fosa.avatar-texture-optimizer
description: NDMF-based VRChat avatar texture optimizer: analyzes mesh UV to texture mappings, scales UV islands by target quality algorithms (MS-SSIM / CIEDE2000 / alpha / normal / grayscale), trims unused UV space, and re-packs textures into one or more atlases to maximize texture utilization while preserving avatar appearance. / 基于NDMF的VRChat Avatar贴图优化工具：分析网格UV到贴图的映射，按目标质量算法缩放UV岛，剔除未使用UV区域，重组合并图集，在保证表现一致的前提下最大化贴图利用率。
